会社概要

ロケットナウは、送料とサービス料が無料のフードデリバリーサービスです。和食、洋食、ヘルシー志向の料理など多彩なジャンルの料理から、デザートやドリンクまで迅速かつお得にお楽しみいただけます。サービスは、北海道、東北（仙台）、関東（東京・神奈川・埼玉・千葉）、中部（愛知・静岡）、関西（大阪・京都・兵庫）、広島、九州（福岡）を中心に展開中です。 ロケットナウアプリは、グローバルマーケットインテリジェンス企業の「センサータワー（Sensor Tower）」が主催する「Sensor Tower APAC Awards 2025」にて、「2025年に世界でローンチされた飲食店注文・フードデリバリーアプリ部門」で「世界最多ダウンロード数を記録」したアプリに認定されました。また、『Best App Award 2025』において、カテゴリ別部門ショッピングカテゴリ優秀賞を受賞。iOS／Androidの両アプリストアのダウンロード数は、フードデリバリーアプリ部門9カ月連続1位を獲得しました
1。アプリはサービス開始
2から15カ月で500万ダウンロードを突破するなど成長を続けています。 ＊1 2025年7〜2026年3月 iOS、Android 統合ベース ＊2 2025年3月30日 サービスリリース時点 （出所：Global Market Intelligence: Sensor Tower）
CP One Japan
について
CP One Japan合同会社は、NYSE（ニューヨーク証券取引所）に上場しているFortune 150のテクノロジー企業Coupang, Inc.（NYSE: CPNG）の日本法人です。CP One Japanは、日本国内で「ロケットナウ（Rocket Now）」ブランドのフードデリバリーサービスを運営しており、Coupangの技術力と革新的な物流ソリューションを生かして、迅速で信頼性の高い顧客志向のフードデリバリーサービスを日本の消費者に提供することに尽力しています。
職務概要
Rocket NowのSales & Business組織において、Sales Agency運用におけるバックオフィス業務およびオペレーション全体の管理・最適化を牽引するポジションです。
契約・登録作業から実績の清算、さらにはデータ分析を通じた改善策の提案までを一気通貫で担い、代理店事業の基盤強化とスムーズな事業運営を支えていただきます。
主なミッション
代理店運用におけるオペレーション全体の統括と、登録・清算プロセス等の円滑なマネジメント
データの可視化（ダッシュボード構築）および分析に基づく、継続的な業務改善の推進
正確かつ迅速な事務管理・問い合わせ対応による、営業組織と代理店のサポート

jobs.description: Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently. Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States). NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position. Key job responsibilities Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS) Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA) Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment Technical writing to support change management program Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations. Role may support more than one location/site. Physical Requirements: Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations: Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational. Essential Requirements: Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs. A day in the life This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment. About the team Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

You desire impactful work.

You’re RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

Coordinates cross functional project teams to develop financing solutions for RGA's regulatory entities. Leads and manages accounting and reporting functions on assigned structured finance transactions. Reviews and analyzes structured finance transaction information ensuring accuracy of data and design. Evaluates and recommends improvements to improve efficiency for internal financing processes.

Principle Duties

•

Manage a project team of professionals of varying levels (including investments, legal, and other corporate partners as needed) to structure and complete complex reinsurance transactions throughout the global organization. Provide a point of leadership as well as coordinate a collaborative effort to develop optimal solutions to meet legal entity and consolidated objectives.

•

Lead negotiations with external parties ensuring that RGA’s financing needs are met efficiently and lead the implementation of legal entity optimization strategies, such as restacking efforts.

Establish processes that ensure financing transactions and support processes are implemented and administered properly.

Supports the department’s internal control and audit compliance process. •

•

Perform other duties as assigned.

Highly advanced oral and written communication skills, demonstrating the ability to convey business terminology that is meaningful and well received required

•

Expert ability to balance detail with departmental goals/objectives required

Highly advanced skills in customer relationship management and change management required

•

Highly advanced ability to make timely and effective decisions and produce results required

Ability to work flexible hours to accommodate international projects across multiple time-zones required

Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

CAS's mission is to support the company in achieving its objectives by employing a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes. Position Description This position builds and delivers best-in-class, end-to-end analytics solutions on Microsoft Fabric, the foundation of the CAS data platform. Working across the full lifecycle, from data engineering, warehousing, and ELT through semantic models, Power BI, and Fabric apps, the individual creates and evolves a portfolio of Fabric solutions that turn CAS data into trusted, self-service intelligence. A core focus is building AI Ready Semantic Models, the governed, contextual data layer that grounds Claude and AI agents in trusted CAS data. Partnering directly with CAS audit teams and stakeholders, the individual translates business needs into working solutions, drives efforts to completion, and grows adoption across the function, delivering high-quality, well-governed solutions within the CAS data architecture and data engine standards. The individual also helps innovate how CAS builds and automates, leveraging Claude Code and beginning to apply agentic frameworks to accelerate development and automate CAS audit and Data Analytics operations. Above all, this is a hands-on builder who thrives on a team of doers, collaborates openly, sets and evolves standards alongside peers, and partners across Finance and the broader Lilly organization to deliver where it creates the most value. Success in this role is as much about how the work gets done as what gets built. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on team of builders who share openly, support one another, and put the team's success first. The individual brings an ownership mindset and a high personal bar, communicates with clarity and empathy, stays humble and curious, and builds trust across CAS and its partners, contributing to a positive culture where people do their best work. Primary Position Responsibilities Fabric Data Engineering & ELT Design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions on Microsoft Fabric, spanning lakehouses, warehouses, and a medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers). Engineer the full ELT lifecycle, building ingestion, transformation, and refresh pipelines with Fabric notebooks and configuration-driven frameworks that are scalable, reusable, and maintainable. Build and maintain data orchestration across solutions, coordinating pipelines, dependencies, scheduling, and refresh. Refactor and migrate existing solutions onto the Fabric platform, following established governance and deployment standards. Apply CI/CD, Git version control, and automated testing that bring engineering rigor and repeatability to solution development. Uphold and extend the CAS data architecture and governance frameworks, keeping solutions secure, well-structured, and maintainable at enterprise scale. Semantic Models, Power BI & Fabric Apps Build data engines and semantic models on Fabric to the CAS data engine standards, primarily using Direct Lake, with strong attention to DAX and model performance for governed, high-performance consumption by Power BI, Fabric apps, and Claude. Develop AI Ready Semantic Models, establishing the holistic contextual layer within the semantic model (definitions, relationships, and business meaning) that makes it consumable by large language models and grounds Claude in trusted CAS data. Leverage Claude, MCP, and Claude Code to build and enrich AI Ready Semantic Models and to innovate how CAS delivers AI-grounded analytics. Own Power BI solution delivery, building dashboards, executive visualizations, and reporting that make data accessible and actionable for stakeholders. Innovate new Fabric app solutions, designing and building Fabric-native applications that extend how CAS delivers and consumes data. Architect self-service analytics that enable stakeholders to explore data without ongoing developer support. Establish enterprise deployment patterns, including shared datasets, deployment pipelines, and version control that bring engineering rigor to analytics delivery. Solution Delivery & Stakeholder Partnership Partner with CAS audit leadership to understand their priorities, workflows, and process pain points, translating them into analytics and automation solutions that measurably improve how audits are executed. Act as a trusted advisor, proactively identifying opportunities to streamline audit processes and bringing forward solutions rather than waiting for requirements. Maintain and evolve a portfolio of Fabric solutions, continuously improving performance, usability, and reliability. Deliver organizational reporting and analytics dashboards for business partners, leaders, and stakeholders. Orchestrate work delivery through Smartsheet, managing intake, prioritization, tracking, and delivery metrics. Operate in an Agile delivery model, driving continuous improvement, adoption, and business value. Automation & Agentic Innovation Automate CAS audit processes, building automation solutions for auditors that reduce manual effort and improve consistency across audit execution. Automate Data Analytics operations, streamlining intake, delivery, and platform tasks to increase team efficiency and quality. Leverage Claude Code and AI-assisted development to accelerate the build and maintenance of Fabric and automation solutions. Pilot autonomous solutioning, applying agentic frameworks to automate build, testing, and operational tasks as this emerging capability matures. Contribute to the CAS Claude Skill strategy, helping create and maintain reusable skills that encode Fabric, solution, and automation capabilities. Pioneer and help define how agentic approaches evolve into AI-native CAS solutions over time, establishing early patterns the team will build on. Technical Leadership & Innovation Set, follow, and evolve technical standards alongside the team, contributing best practices, design patterns, and reusable templates to the shared Confluence repository referenced across Data Analytics and CAS. Lead solution design for complex analytics and data challenges, shaping the approach and bringing peers along collaboratively. Own delivery end to end, driving efforts to completion and taking accountability for quality, performance, and outcomes. Contribute to solution and code reviews, exchanging feedback with peers to keep quality, consistency, and governance high across the team. Advance how CAS builds, evaluating and piloting emerging Fabric, analytics, and agentic capabilities and sharing what works so the whole team benefits. Share knowledge and enablement, helping build collective capability on Fabric, semantic modeling, Power BI, and AI tools. Basic Qualifications / Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related technical degree. 5+ years of relevant professional experience in data engineering, analytics, or data solution development within a global, matrixed organization. Additional Skills / Preferences Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end data solution delivery and setting technical standards that others follow, including through solution and design reviews. Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience (preferred) or a similar cloud data platform, including Lakehouse and warehouse design, medallion architecture, notebooks, and the full ELT lifecycle. Strong semantic modeling proficiency, including advanced DAX, model design, and performance optimization. Power BI and Fabric app delivery as a presentation layer, including dashboards, executive visualizations, and Fabric-native applications. Data engineering languages and tools (Python, PySpark, SQL) and configuration-driven, automated data pipelines across diverse source systems. Power BI and Fabric app delivery as a presentation layer, including dashboards, executive visualizations, and Fabric-native applications. Reinsurance Deal Onboarding

Collaboration & Communication

• Model design, control and governance best practices

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Integrity & Compliance (I&C) function is building the systems that let us scale responsibly as our products reach more people, more enterprises, and more regulated industries. Our global compliance program is bespoke, reflecting our unique mission and position as one of the leading AI labs operating on the frontier.

Our Regulatory Programs pillar is a key pillar of our overall Integrity & Compliance function and covers a range of compliance domain areas including economic sanctions, US export controls, and regulatory compliance programs stemming from global content and AI regulation.

As Sanctions Compliance Lead, you will take day-to-day leadership of Anthropic's sanctions compliance program and support oversight of our export controls program, supporting the Regulatory Programs lead as a senior leader within the function. This is a leadership seat in a domain where the rules governing AI models and compute are still being written, and where sanctions exposure runs through globally accessible APIs, downstream and embedded-partner channels, and rapid geographic expansion.

You will own the sanctions program end to end: setting strategy and risk appetite with leadership, continuously assessing risk and driving remediation and program enhancements, governing our screening and enforcement controls, directing regulator-facing matters, and reporting on program health to I&C leadership and the Audit Committee. You will partner closely with our in-house Trade Compliance Counsel on interpretation of applicable law, represent the function with senior stakeholders, and lead and develop trade compliance professionals as the team grows. This is a builder's role at a company that takes integrity seriously and moves fast. You will exercise independent judgment on issues without clear precedent and build durable programs that let Anthropic move quickly while honoring its obligations to regulators, customers, and the public.

•

Lead Anthropic's sanctions compliance program, including strategy, risk appetite, policy frameworks, and the program roadmap, and keep them current as regulations and the business evolve

•

Represent the sanctions and export controls function with senior leadership and cross-functional partners, and step in for the Regulatory Programs lead across the function as needed

Continuously assess sanctions risk across products, channels, and markets, and own the remediation of identified issues and the delivery of program enhancements, in partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, Finance, and first-line teams

Monitor sanctions regulatory developments and enforcement actions, assess impact on Anthropic, and drive required program changes

Lead, mentor, and develop compliance team members, and help shape the structure of the function as it grows

SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Power Generation team is seeking an Electrical Technician to operate and maintain plant electrical systems at SpaceX’s power generation facility. You will work hands-on across medium-voltage generation, distribution, and balance-of-plant electrical equipment up to 13.5 kV and 34.8 kV. This is an operations and maintenance role — you will switch, troubleshoot, repair, and keep electrical systems online in a high-reliability, fast-paced plant environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform operations and maintenance on plant electrical systems, including generators, transformers, switchgear, motor control centers, motors, VFDs, UPS units, automatic transfer switches, and emergency/black-start equipment, at voltages up to 13.5 kV and 34.8 kV.
• Execute switching, isolation, LOTO, racking of breakers, and restoration of medium-voltage equipment in accordance with plant procedures and NFPA 70E.
• Troubleshoot electrical faults on power distribution, protection, grounding, lighting, and auxiliary systems using one-line diagrams, schematics, and electrical test equipment.
• Perform preventive and predictive maintenance, inspections, and repairs to improve reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.
• Support plant startups, shutdowns, outages, and commissioning activities alongside operators, controls technicians, and engineers.
• Install, terminate, and maintain plant electrical equipment, cable, and control wiring as required for operations and maintenance work.
• Respond to electrical alarms, trips, and equipment failures; support root-cause investigations and implement corrective actions.
• Coordinate with operations, engineering, and utility personnel on switching, clearances, and electrical work that affects plant generation.
• Maintain accurate work orders, switching records, and as-found/as-left documentation.
• Follow all safety, LOTO, arc-flash, and PPE requirements while working in energized and hazardous plant environments.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate
• 3+ years of experience as an electrical technician, industrial electrician, or similar role maintaining industrial or power generation electrical systems.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience operating and maintaining medium-voltage electrical systems (4.16 kV to 34.8 kV), including switchgear, transformers, and breakers.
• Experience in a power plant, generating station, or other high-reliability industrial facility.
• Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, electrical schematics, and equipment O&M manuals.
• Experience with LOTO, switching procedures, and NFPA 70E / arc-flash safety practices.
• Experience troubleshooting motors, VFDs, MCCs, UPS systems, and plant auxiliary electrical equipment.
• Familiarity with electrical test equipment (multimeters, insulation testers, infrared, and similar).
• Journeyman electrician license or equivalent formal electrical training.
• Experience using a CMMS or work-order system to plan and close maintenance work.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a multi-discipline operations and maintenance team.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights.
• Ability to work extended hours, nights, weekends, and rotating or on-call schedules to support plant operations.
• Ability to remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE.
• Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted.
• Lifting, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required to perform the functions of this position.
• Must be able to work on-site at the power generation facility, with potential travel to other SpaceX sites.
